6110.title: Deferred rename focus in the iOS shell
6110.rootCauseOneLine: Inline rename focuses and selects in a later animation frame; the native shell retains user-action keyboard gating. Native suppression is not device-verified.
6110.proposedFix: First verify the timing/user-action mismatch on iOS; then preserve gesture-time focus without broad native keyboard-policy changes.
6110.caveats: Only DOM timing reproduced twice. No iOS device, simulator, or Chrome is available; no native keyboard screenshot or TestFlight execution. Full build blocked by an unrelated missing built SDK module.
